replacement.title: Oak Bridge Search-Index Spam Cleanup
replacement.definition: Submit malicious Oak Bridge search-result URLs for removal from search engines.

items.decision_note: Oak Bridge search-index cleanup is an independent operational behavior, and its access request and link submissions do not belong to the South Pointe cleanup or malware-removal Requirements.
The evidence does not safely establish whether full Thrive removal was client-confirmed or merely proposed and deferred while only Thrive Apprentice was disabled.

items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

unresolved_candidate.description: The client tentatively suggests removing Thrive, but the legacy site still depends on it and the freelancer proposes deferring full removal while disabling only Thrive Apprentice. It is unclear whether full Thrive migration/removal became a confirmed Requirement.
Contact-form email delivery is identified as behavior that should be preserved after South Pointe remediation, but no client confirmation or observed test result establishes a clear lifecycle.
The freelancer identifies a potentially incorrect Stape Conversion Tracking container URL, but the client does not resolve whether the configuration is intentional before wrapping up.

Oak Bridge private-page and contact-form functionality could constitute narrower preservation Requirements, but the supplied history contains only requests for client testing and no target-specific observed outcomes.
